backend/main.mo: Motoko backend with access control, user profiles, balances, onboarding, admin wallet management, and order storage.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature requests to affected frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Pre-generated summaries describing the purpose of each major frontend file.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind and theme variable definitions for light/dark modes and base styling.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entrypoint mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router with routes for all app pages and renders the router provider.
frontend/src/components/AdminDiagnostics: Debug card showing admin status, admin wallet state, and normalized backend errors.
frontend/src/components/AppFooter.tsx: Footer with referral link sharing, copy-to-clipboard, credits link, and branding.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Renders the main header with logo and conditional profile or signup button, and updates a CSS offset based on header height.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Provides the main layout with background, balance indicator, routing outlet, and triggers onboarding once per authenticated user.
frontend/src/components/BalanceIndicator: Displays the user's balance with refresh, admin wallet status info, and contextual hints based on auth and balance state.
frontend/src/components/OrderConfirmatio: Shows order confirmation details including package info, price, video URL, and next-step instructions with navigation buttons.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor tied to the user's identity, initializing access control and invalidating dependent queries on change.
Determines and returns canonical UI state for the admin wallet based on auth, loading state, and backend response.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUrl.ts: Returns the current browser URL on mount.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context with login, logout, identity loading, and status tracking using Dfinity AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useOrders.ts: Handles order creation with balance deductions and admin wallet updates, and fetches individual orders via backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for user profile, balance, admin checks, admin wallet actions, and fund distribution with actor-based backend calls.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles, theme CSS variables, dark mode colors, and utility classes for safe-area positioning.
frontend/src/lib/backendError.ts: Normalizes backend error messages and detects authorization-related errors.
frontend/src/lib/copyToClipboard.ts: Implements clipboard copying using the Clipboard API with a fallback for older browsers.
frontend/src/lib/format.ts: Contains formatting helpers for timestamps, order IDs, PKR amounts, and bigint balances.
frontend/src/lib/packages.ts: Defines package metadata for purchasable view bundles, including prices, descriptions, and benefits.
frontend/src/lib/validation.ts: Provides URL validation ensuring non-empty and valid HTTP/HTTPS URLs.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard for viewing admin wallet balance and topping it up with validation and error handling.
frontend/src/pages/AdminUsersPage.tsx: Displays an admin-only user list with balances and clipboard copy support, handling loading and unauthorized states.
frontend/src/pages/CreditsPage.tsx: Displays a credits page with tool info, features, contact links, and an educational-use disclaimer.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Admin dashboard for managing orders, distributing funds, checking wallet status, and validating TikTok URLs.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main landing page allowing users to select packages, validate URLs, and create new orders.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Profile management page enabling users to view, edit, and save personal details and avatar.
frontend/src/pages/SignUpPage.tsx: Handles Internet Identity signup flow and redirects new users to profile setup.
frontend/src/pages/StatusPage.tsx: Renders a TikTok order status page that handles loading, error, and success states using fetched order data and UI components.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters with fallback to sessionStorage, supporting hash-based routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind theme, colors, fonts, animations, and plugins including typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Defines project state, known issues, and feature requirements related to fixing inconsistent admin wallet recognition logic on the dashboard.
